stop_open.speaker: player
stop_open.text: (The bellwether dies three streets from the house. By sunrise, black ash lies against the front step like dirty snow.)

join_open.speaker: player
join_open.text: (The bellwether dies beneath the transit station. Faelen carries you through the closing gate; you carry her the last two blocks home.)

n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (You find her in the kitchen before dawn, scrubbing black blood from her hands. The water has long since run clear.)

n3.speaker: faelen
n3.text: It is dead. The trail is broken. The house is safe.

n6.speaker: player
n6.text: "Then tell me what you're trying to wash off."

n8.speaker: faelen
n8.text: There were forty-two Wardens at the eastern line. I commanded eleven.

n9.speaker: faelen
n9.text: The first seal failed. We had time to withdraw. Then I saw the bellwether beyond the breach and believed killing it would stop the host.

n11.speaker: player
n11.text: (Rain worries at the kitchen window. Somewhere upstairs, the old pipes knock.)

n12.speaker: faelen
n12.text: Tirren was nineteen. He lied about his age to enlist. Sava had a daughter who drew birds on every letter. Pell complained about my tea and drank it every morning.

n13.speaker: faelen
n13.text: I gave the order. They trusted me. The gate changed shape behind us, and all eleven died buying me a path through.

n14.speaker: player
n14.text: "So you decided surviving was the crime."

n15.speaker: faelen
n15.text: Do not make it smaller so I can bear it.

n16.speaker: player
n16.text: "I'm not. I'm saying eleven people chose to save you, and you've spent every day since trying to overrule them."

n17.speaker: faelen
n17.text: You tear answers out of wounds and call it honesty.

n18.speaker: faelen
n18.text: You gave me silence until I could fill it. I hated you for making it safe enough to speak.

n19.speaker: faelen
n19.text: I know every reason I should leave. I had them arranged like weapons.

n20.speaker: faelen
n20.text: Then you kept handing me ordinary things. A chair at the table. My cup beside yours. Someone expecting me back.

n21.speaker: faelen
n21.text: I let you close. I wanted you close. And wanting it frightens me more than any creature I have hunted.

choices.text: "What happened does not disqualify you from being loved. Neither does being afraid."
(Turn off the tap. Take her wet, shaking hand and stay.)

love3.speaker: faelen
love3.text: You have never been subtle in your life.

quiet1.speaker: player
quiet1.text: (Her fingers close around yours by degrees, as if each one requires a separate act of courage.)

n22.speaker: faelen
n22.text: Pell was right about the tea.
